webui_port.description: Port number for the Web UI (corresponds to --webui-port=x)

no_splash.description: Whether to disable the splash screen on startup (corresponds to --no-splash)

webui_address.description: IP address to bind the Web UI to

webui_base_path.description: Base path for Web UI API requests

webui_secure.description: Whether to enable HTTPS for the Web UI

webui_cert_path.description: Path to the HTTPS certificate file

webui_key_path.description: Path to the HTTPS private key file

webui_auth_method.description: Authentication method for Web UI: 'http' or 'local'

webui_username.description: Username for local Web UI authentication

webui_password.description: Password for local Web UI authentication (typically stored hashed)
